goblin-trouble.name: Goblin trouble
goblin-trouble.summary: Goblins have been seen at the old watchtower. Warden Hale wants them gone before they settle in.

steps.text: Kill the goblins at the watchtower (3).

standing-stones.name: The standing stones
standing-stones.summary: With the tower quiet, the warden wants to know what draws the goblins to the old stones.

steps.text: Tell Warden Hale what you found.
